llm.summary: This is a legitimate planning skill, but it automatically shares brainstorming context with other agent workflows and continues into later phases without a clear confirmation step.

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is coherent: Socratic project brainstorming that produces a project brief and compares approaches. Its War Room, review, and specification handoffs are related to planning quality, but they extend it beyond a simple brainstorming helper.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifact requires automatic invocation of attune:war-room, automatic handoff to attune:project-specification, and a subagent spec review loop. It explicitly says not to prompt for confirmation before continuation, which weakens user control over workflow boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown instruction files only, with no bundled executable scripts, binaries, dependencies, or install-time code. Static scan findings were clean, and VirusTotal telemetry is pending rather than negative.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill writes purpose-related planning artifacts such as docs/project-brief.md and .attune/brainstorm-session.json. It does not request credentials, privileged system access, destructive commands, or broad filesystem indexing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to project planning files, but the skill saves potentially sensitive brainstorming state and can pass all brainstorming context to other skills or subagents without a prominent privacy or approval gate.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an opinionated multi-step planning workflow, not just chat-only brainstorming. Avoid entering secrets or highly confidential project details unless you are comfortable with them being saved in project files and passed to related Attune skills or review agents. Use the standalone or skip-review options when you want to stop after the brief or avoid extra agent review.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Automatic continuation to a specification phase is related to the Attune planning workflow and is disclosed in the artifact, but the no-confirmation instruction creates a material user-control concern.
[SDI-2] expected: War Room delegation supports approach pressure testing, but the artifact mandates transfer of all brainstorming context to a multi-LLM workflow with limited user gating.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger terms match planning and ideation use cases, but broad triggers are more concerning because this skill also writes files and chains into other workflows.
[SQP-2] expected: Saving docs/project-brief.md and .attune/brainstorm-session.json is purpose-aligned, but the artifact does not prominently warn that brainstorming content may be persisted locally.
[SQP-2] expected: Passing brainstorming context to War Room is disclosed and related to deliberation, but it should be treated as sensitive data sharing and should ideally be opt-in.
